Energia Rates and Tariffs
Compare Energia’s latest electricity and gas rates across smart meter, EV, dual fuel and standard tariffs, with clear unit-rate and standing-charge breakdowns that help you cut through the small print and see what you’ll actually pay.

compare Energia electricity plans
to find the best option for your home.

Microgeneration
Microgeneration rates
Microgeneration
is the process of producing your own electricity at home, typically using renewable sources such as
solar panels
. If you generate excess electricity, you may be eligible to receive credit for exporting energy back to the grid. These payments are usually applied as a credit on your electricity bill and can help reduce overall energy costs.
View microgeneration rates
FAQs About energy rates Ireland:
What are Energia electricity peak, day and night times?
Night and peak electricity times depend on the type of meter you have.
If you have a Smart meter, it automatically adjusts for daylight savings. Your night rate runs from 11pm to 8am all year round.
If you have an MCC02 meter, it doesn’t adjust for daylight savings. So:
From late March to late October, night rate is from 12am to 9am
From late October to late March, it goes back to 11pm to 8am
If you have an MCC12 meter, your peak time is between 5pm to 7pm.
Does Energia offer different tariffs for day/night meters?
Yes, Energia offers different tariffs for day/night meters. We provide specific plans such as the
Smart Day/Night tariff
, which features two time bands with cheaper night rates, allowing customers to save by using electricity during off-peak hours.
What is a unit rate (kWh)?
A unit rate is the cost per kilowatt hour (kWh) of electricity or gas you use. It’s the main variable cost on your energy bill.
What is a standing charge?
A standing charge is a fixed daily cost for maintaining your connection to the energy network, regardless of usage.
What is the difference between smart meter and standard tariffs?
Smart tariffs use time-based pricing (day, night, peak), while standard tariffs use either a single 24-hour rate or a day/night structure.

.gw-launchpad-icon-fill {
  fill: black;
  fill: var(--iconFillColor, var(--iconFillColor));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10px;
  height: 3.5em;
  width: 3.5em;
  border-radius: 35px;
  padding: 0.4em;
  margin: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--transparent);
  background-color: rgba(220, 223, 228, 0.5);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundDefaultColor, var(--icon-button-background-default-color));
  /** Mobile icon Buttons
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** ---- **/
  /** Icon Button Size Three
  ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** Mobile Floating Button
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** Mobile Square Button
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** Mobile & Launchpad Floating Action Button Colours
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon {
  color: white;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  fill: black;
  fill: var(--toolbarIconButtonFillColor, var(--fontColorDark));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:disabled,
.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon[disabled] {
  background-color: var(--transparent);
  border-color: var(--transparent);
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:visited {
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:hover {
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--iconButtonBackgroundDefaultColor, var(--icon-button-border-color));
  background-color: rgba(220, 223, 228, 0.5);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundHoverColor, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:hover,
.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:focus {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:active {
  color: var(--fontColorDark, black);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--icon-button-border-color, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
  background-color: rgba(220, 223, 228, 0.5);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundActiveColor, var(--icon-button-background-active-color));
  background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 0.135);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundActiveColorNoBackground, var(--icon-button-background-active-color-no-background));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button:not(:last-child) {
  margin-right: .25em;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button:hover {
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--icon-button-border-color, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundHoverColor, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button:active {
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--icon-button-border-color, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
  background-color: rgba(36, 42, 56, 0.12);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundActiveColor, var(--icon-button-background-active-color));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon {
  top: -.1em;
  right: -.1em;
  height: 1.3em;
  width: 1.3em;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--s2b {
  width: 1.7em;
  height: 1.7em;
  top: -1px;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--s2 {
  width: 1.9em;
  height: 1.9em;
  top: -1px;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--s3 {
  width: 2.2em;
  height: 2.2em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--app-floating {
  width: 3.2em;
  height: 3.2em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--app-square {
  width: 3.5em;
  height: 3.5em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--launchpad-s1 {
  width: auto;
  height: 3.2em;

<script>
    function openAccountsDDL() {
        let ddl = document.querySelector("#account__dropdown-items ul");
        let btn = document.querySelector("#account-dropdown-btn");

        if (ddl) {
            const isOpen = ddl.style.display === "block";
            ddl.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "block";

            if (btn) {
                btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!isOpen));
            }

            if (!isOpen) {
                trapFocus(ddl, btn);
            } else {
                releaseFocus();
            }
        }
    }

    function trapFocus(container, triggerBtn) {
        const focusableSelectors = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
        const focusableElements = container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors);
        const first = focusableElements[0];
        const last = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];

        if (first) first.focus();

        function handleKeyDown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                openAccountsDDL();
                triggerBtn.focus();
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                if (e.shiftKey) {
                    if (document.activeElement === first) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        last.focus();
                    }
                } else {
                    if (document.activeElement === last) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        first.focus();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

        document._accountMenuHandler = handleKeyDown;
    }

    function releaseFocus() {
        if (document._accountMenuHandler) {
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', document._accountMenuHandler);
            document._accountMenuHandler = null;
        }
    }
</script>

                                <button id="accordionControl-ad9f1854c6a564b6aa44e61623b6a9bce" class="accordion__control" data-click-text="What are Energia electricity peak, day and night times?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-ad9f1854c6a564b6aa44e61623b6a9bce" data-accordion-control="" data-adobe-accordion-block="Collapsible Panel" data-adobe-accordion-title="What are Energia electricity peak, day and night times?">

                                       <svg width="26" height="24" viewBox="0 0 26 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                            <div id="accordionPanel-ad9f1854c6a564b6aa44e61623b6a9bce" class="accordion__panel" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-ad9f1854c6a564b6aa44e61623b6a9bce" hidden="">
                                <p>Night and peak electricity times depend on the type of meter you have.</p>

<p>If you have a Smart meter, it automatically adjusts for daylight savings. Your night rate runs from 11pm to 8am all year round.</p>

<p>If you have an MCC02 meter, it doesn’t adjust for daylight savings. So:</p>

<ul>
	<li>From late March to late October, night rate is from 12am to 9am</li>
	<li>From late October to late March, it goes back to 11pm to 8am</li>
</ul>

<p>If you have an MCC12 meter, your peak time is between 5pm to 7pm.</p>

                                <p>Yes, Energia offers different tariffs for day/night meters. We provide specific plans such as the <a href="/guide-to-smart-meters/best-smart-plans">Smart Day/Night tariff</a>, which features two time bands with cheaper night rates, allowing customers to save by using electricity during off-peak hours.</p>

                                <p>A unit rate is the cost per kilowatt hour (kWh) of electricity or gas you use. It’s the main variable cost on your energy bill.</p>

                                <p>A standing charge is a fixed daily cost for maintaining your connection to the energy network, regardless of usage.</p>

                                <p>Smart tariffs use time-based pricing (day, night, peak), while standard tariffs use either a single 24-hour rate or a day/night structure. </p>

FAQs about our Electricity Price Plans:
How do I compare electricity plans in Ireland?
Compare the unit rate, standing charge,
average electricity bill
, discount, contract length and whether the plan suits your meter type and usage habits.
How long is the Energia electricity contract?
Energia electricity contracts are available for either 12 or 24 months. If you end your contract early (before the 12-month period is up), a termination fee will apply. See our full
terms and conditions
for more details.
What times are night and peak rate electricity charged?
Night and peak rate times depend on your meter type and tariff. For smart meters, the night rate is usually 11pm to 8am all year round and adjusts automatically for daylight savings. For MCC02 day/night meters, the night rate is 12am to 9am from late March to late October and 11pm to 8am from late October to late March. For MCC12 smart data meters, the peak rate is usually 5pm to 7pm. Shifting electricity use to off-peak or night-rate hours may help reduce your costs. Learn more about how a
time-of-use tariff
works.
I am elderly and worried about my power supply being disconnected in winter. What can I do?
If you’re aged 66 or over, you can
register as a Vulnerable Customer
. Once registered, you’ll be added to the Special Services Register, which protects you from electricity or gas disconnection during winter months, from 1st November to 31st March.
Ready to switch?
The quickest way to switch to Energia is online. However, if you prefer to speak with an advisor or need assistance, you can request a call back, and one of our experts will contact you at a time that suits you best.
Request a call back
Switch now

<script>
    function openAccountsDDL() {
        let ddl = document.querySelector("#account__dropdown-items ul");
        let btn = document.querySelector("#account-dropdown-btn");

        if (ddl) {
            const isOpen = ddl.style.display === "block";
            ddl.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "block";

            if (btn) {
                btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!isOpen));
            }

            if (!isOpen) {
                trapFocus(ddl, btn);
            } else {
                releaseFocus();
            }
        }
    }

    function trapFocus(container, triggerBtn) {
        const focusableSelectors = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
        const focusableElements = container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors);
        const first = focusableElements[0];
        const last = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];

        if (first) first.focus();

        function handleKeyDown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                openAccountsDDL();
                triggerBtn.focus();
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                if (e.shiftKey) {
                    if (document.activeElement === first) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        last.focus();
                    }
                } else {
                    if (document.activeElement === last) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        first.focus();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

        document._accountMenuHandler = handleKeyDown;
    }

    function releaseFocus() {
        if (document._accountMenuHandler) {
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', document._accountMenuHandler);
            document._accountMenuHandler = null;
        }
    }
</script>

Understanding your energy bill
A guide to reading your electricity and gas bill
Need help reading your bill?
Find easy to follow guides for standard bills, smart bills and microgeneration payments below
Standard bill
Smart bill
Microgeneration bill
Understanding your bill
Watch our standard bill explainer video to understand more about your gas and electricity bills. If you still need help, contact us below.
Contact us
Energy bills can be confusing..
But we’re here to help break it down for you with this short guide to the key information that is included on your bill and what it means for you and your home.
What is a utility bill?
A utility bill is a statement that shows how much you owe for essential services such as electricity or gas. It includes details of your energy usage over a set period, along with charges, taxes, and any applicable discounts. Your Energia bill is a type of utility bill, showing exactly how much energy your home has used and how your final cost is calculated.
How your bill is calculated:
Your electricity or gas meter records the amount of energy your home has used. ESB Networks or Gas Networks Ireland will read your meter four times per year and share the readings with us to calculate your bill. Outside of these times, we may ask you to provide us with a meter reading to ensure your bill is kept accurate and to avoid estimate readings. Your actual bill will vary depending on your usage, tariff and meter type. You can compare your costs with the
average electricity bill in Ireland
and learn how annual energy costs are estimated.
If you have a Smart Meter your meter readings will be automatically sent to the network operators and shared with us to calculate your bill. Please note, depending on your CTF status, bills may be estimated.
How you will be billed:
If you have registered for an Energia online account, you will receive your bill online. We will email you to let you know when you have new bill available to view and you can simply log into your online account either on web or via our free smartphone app, to see your latest bill, account balance and the option to download a copy of your bill (and any bill within your account, up to two years).
If you have not yet registered for an Energia online account, you will receive your bills by post.
Your electricity & gas bills:
Electricity and gas are billed separately so, if you’re a Dual Fuel customer, you will receive two separate bills one for electricity and one for gas and each will be paid separately. These bills may not arrive together at the same time and this is normal, don’t worry.
Your electricity and gas bill information
Your bill will contain two pages of information and it Is important that you review both pages to ensure everything is up to date and as expected.
Page 1
Page 2
A summary of your current account balance
Account balance before
Cost of your bill
New account balance
If your account is currently in credit you will see the letter '
CR
'
Indicates a breakdown of your usage, showing the costs in more detail. If your bill amount has been calculated based on an estimate meter reading you'll see the letter ‘
E
’ in your bill.
If you spot something that doesn’t seem right, check out our Help and Support centre for helpful answers to many billing queries or contact us if you need to chat to our billing team.
Understanding Your Bill
Energia is a member of EAI: Electricity Association of Ireland and we are pleased to support the launch of a new Energy Bill Guide to help customers feel more confident about their electricity bills and everyday energy use.
The guide explains how bills are put together and helps customers to better understand the impact of how and when they use electricity, including the role smart meters can play.
Read the guide here
What to look for on your bill
Page 1:
In the top right-hand corner, you will find most of the key account information which includes:
1. Your account number:
This is your Energia account number which identifies your electricity or gas account. You may wish to make note of this number as it will be required should you need to contact us or if you would like to register for an Energia online account.
2. Your MPRN or GPRN:
Your MPRN (Meter Point Reference Number) of GPRN (Gas Meter Point Reference Number) identifies your meter connection with ESB Network or Gas Networks Ireland and these numbers will be unique to your home.
3. Billing period and due date:
Your billing period dates relate to the timeframe of the electricity usage you are being billed for. The due date is the date which you must pay your bill by.
If you are a Level Pay customer, you don’t need to take any action as the cost of your bills will be covered within your monthly direct debit payments which are collected automatically on the due date indicated on your bill.
Also read:
Understanding
proration in billing
.
Is Level Pay worth it?
4. Bill invoice number:
Each bill has its own invoice number to reference.
5. Tariff:
This indicates the current Energia energy plan you are being billed on. If your tariff no longer suits your usage, you can
compare Energia electricity plans
to find a plan that better matches your home, meter type and energy habits.
Page 2:
This is the more detailed itemisation of the costs which make up your final bill amount.  When a price change comes into effect, customer bills will show a breakdown of usage and charges on the old rates and the new rates.
For example, if there is a price change scheduled for the 07 October some of your bill will be calculated using the old rate; this will be based on the number of days before the 07 October and the remainder of your bill will be calculated using the new rate from the 07 October onwards.
Bill details:
Your meter reading at the start of the billing period
Your meter reading at the end of the billing period
The number of units you have used during the billing period
Standing charge and discounts based on your plan
Transaction summary will include:
The standing charge
Which is a standard cost of supplying your energy.
Any discounts
Any discounts – Depending on your plan you may receive online billing or promotional discounts
The cost of units used
Your energy and usage during the billing period and VAT & the final bill amount
Billing FAQs
Accessing and managing bills
Can I pay my bill online?
Yes, you can pay your bill online through your Energia online account.
Why register for Energy Online?
You get 24/7 access to view your bills and make payments conveniently.
You can use our
Fast Pay service
to make advance payments towards your energy bills.
All payments are secure and easy to manage.
Register for
Energy Online here
.
Can I get my bill online instead of by post?
Yes, you can choose to receive your Energia bill online.
Simply register for our Energy Online service, and your bills will be:
Emailed directly to you
Available to view anytime through your online account
This option is secure, convenient, and helps you manage your bills more easily, while also reducing paper waste. You may also be eligible for a discount of 4% on your bill if you choose to receive your bill online.
Register for Energy Online here
What payment options does Energia Provide?
We offer a range of payment options to suit different needs and help you manage your energy bills with ease:
1. Direct Debit
The full bill amount is automatically taken from your bank account 14 days after your bill is issued.
It’s a hassle-free way to stay on top of payments and you may be eligible for discounts when you choose this option.
2. FastPay
A quick and easy way to make debit or credit card payments online.
You can add credit to your account, which will be deducted from your next bill.
Great for building up credit.
3. Level Pay
Spread your estimated annual energy costs evenly over 12 monthly payments.
Monthly payments are calculated based on consumption and we review at least once a year and encourage customers to regularly log in to their online account to review bills.
We will notify you in advance of any changes to your monthly payment.
When do I have to pay my bill?
The Payment Due Date is indicated on the top of the bill. This is generally 14 days after the bill is issued.
Will I receive one bill for both electricity and gas?
If you're a Dual Fuel customer with Energia, you'll receive two separate bills, one for electricity and one for gas.
Here’s why:
Electricity and gas are billed separately, based on the meter reading schedules of ESB Networks (electricity) and Gas Networks Ireland (gas).
Your bills may be issued on different dates, and each payment will be processed separately.
Do Energia accept Social Welfare payments?
The Social Welfare can’t pay Energia directly, but you can organise for them to make payment directly to you. You will need to make Social Welfare aware when you change supplier.
How can I reduce my bills?
There are a few simple ways to lower your energy bills:
1. Choose the right payment options
You can get discounts by paying your bill through Direct Debit or by signing up for online billing.
2. Check your energy plan
Make sure you're on a plan that suits your needs. If you're not sure, we can help you review your options. Call our customer support line at
0818 405 405
to review your options.
3. Use less energy at home
Small changes can make a big difference. We’ve put together an Energy Efficiency Tips Guide with practical ideas to help you save energy and money.
Visit our
Energy Efficiency Tips Guide
to get started.
I am struggling to pay my bill – what can I do?
Please contact us as soon as you start having difficulty paying your bill. The sooner we know, the sooner we can help.
Here’s how we can support you:
We understand financial hardship happens, and we’ll work with you to find the best payment arrangement.
This may include installing a prepayment meter to help manage your account.
If you ask, we can also work with charities or third-party agencies to support you. Your information will always be treated in strict confidence.
Under the
EAI Energy Engage Code
, we will never disconnect a customer who engages with us to find a solution.
You can reach our Payment and Accounts Resolutions team by phone on
0818 642 642
or email
PAR@energia.ie
. Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.
I have a carer/relative/friend who normally looks after my bills. Can you send my bill to them?
Yes, we can arrange to send your bills to someone you trust. If a carer, relative or friend helps you manage your bills, we can redirect your bills to them, with your permission.
To do this:
Fill in our
online form
Or
contact our Customer Care team
I am blind or visually impaired. How can I receive my bill?
We offer several accessible billing options to support customers who are blind or visually impaired.
You can choose to receive your bill in one of the following formats:
Braille bill
Large print bill - easier to read and designed for better visibility
Talk-through option - We can call you and go through your bill details with you over the phone
How to request this service:
You can fill in an
online form
Or you can
contact our Customer Care team
We’ll make sure your billing experience is tailored to your needs and handled with care.
Do Energia accept cheque payments?
We do not recommend posting and paying with cheques. Energia does not accept responsibility for any unaccounted for cheques. We would recommend paying by direct debit or through your
Energy Online account
.
I receive the Department of Social Protection allowance for electricity or gas. Can I still switch?
Yes of course. You will still receive the allowance. The Department will pay it directly into your bank account and then you use it to pay your bill. Just give the Department a call when you're switching to check all your details are correct.
Bill understanding and calculation
How is my bill calculated?
Your Energia bill is based on how much electricity or gas you use. Here’s a simple breakdown of how we calculate it:
1. Reading your meter:
We measure your energy use in units from your electricity and/or gas meter. ESB Networks (for electricity) and Gas Networks Ireland (for gas) read your meter about four times a year.
If a recent reading isn’t available, we’ll use an estimated reading based on your previous usage.
Or you can send us your own meter reading  through your
Energy Online account
to make your bill more accurate.
2. Working out your usage
We look at the meter readings at the start and end of your billing period to see how much energy you used.
If our prices changed during that time, we split your usage:
- Units used before the change are charged at the old price.
- Units used after the change are charged at the new price.
3. Your plan (tariff)
We multiply the number of units you used by the price per unit in your energy plan.
4. Other charges on your bill also includes:
A daily standing charge (a fixed cost)
VAT (Value Added Tax)
Government charges like:
- The PSO Levy (for electricity)
- Carbon Tax (for gas)
Want to understand your bill better?
Check out our
Understanding Your Energia Bill Guide
My bill looks complicated – can you help me understand it?
Absolutely, we know your Energia bill might look a little different from what you're used to, and we're here to help. To make things easier, we’ve created a simple guide that explains each part of your bill in plain language.
View our
Understanding Your Bill Guide here
What are Unit Rates?
Unit rates are the price you pay for each unit of energy you use. Energy is measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh), that’s the amount of electricity used to power things like lights, appliances or heating. Each kWh you use is called a unit.
To work out your energy cost, we multiply:
-The number of units you’ve used
- By the price per unit in your plan (your unit rate)
You’ll see your unit rates clearly listed on your bill, so you can understand how your charges are calculated.
What if I am a multi-rate customer?
If your electricity plan includes different rates for different times of day (like Day, Night or Peak hours), your bill will still look the same as usual. However, if our prices change, you’ll see an extra line on your bill for each rate. This shows the new price per unit for that time period.
What is a standing charge?
A standing charge is a daily fee that helps cover the cost of keeping your home connected to the energy grid.
The fee helps cover the costs of services like:
Meter reading
Network maintenance
Operating costs for supplying energy to your home
This charge is applied to your bill as a daily rate, and the total amount depends on the length of your billing period, usually around 60 days, though this can vary slightly. We include this charge to ensure your energy supply is reliable and well-maintained.
What is the PSO Levy?
The PSO (Public Service Obligation) levy is a charge set by the Irish Government and applied to all electricity customers in Ireland.
It helps support the generation of electricity from:
Renewable sources (like wind and solar)
Sustainable and indigenous sources (produced within Ireland)
The levy is reviewed and set each year by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities (CRU) and appears as a separate item on your electricity bill. In some cases, the levy may be negative, meaning you’ll receive a credit on your bill instead of a charge.
Why is there an adjustment on my bill?
Sometimes we will have to add an adjustment to your bill, these adjustments should be labelled to explain what the adjustment relates to, or you may have received an email in advance. If you ever need clarification on any adjustments, please contact us on
0818 405 405
Mon-Fri 9am-5pm.
For Smart tariff customers we may receive replacement data from
ESBN
, an example of this would be ‘
ESBN
replacement data adjustment’ this will show what additional credits or debits we need to apply to your bill. This could be related to poor connectivity or storm outages.
In addition,
ESBN
had a look-back exercise late 2025 and supplied Energia with historical replacement data which will be applied to customers’ bills from 27th January 2026.
Payment Accounts Resolution Team (1)
Are the Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team here to help?
Yes, they are here to support you. The team’s main goal is to help customers early, so you do not fall behind on your bills.
Here’s what they do:
They listen to each customer as an individual and offer advice that suits your situation.
They aim to find the right solution for you, not a one-size-fits-all answer.
They treat every customer with care and respect.
How to contact them:
Call:
0818 642 642
Email:
PAR@energia.ie
Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm
Should I ignore a letter, SMS, call or email from the  Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team?
No, the team are trying to contact you to give you an update on your account with Energia. The sooner we speak to you, the sooner we can help you with your account, or overdue balance
When should I call the Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team?
You should get in touch with our Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team if:
You're finding it difficult to pay your energy bills
You need to set up a different payment plan
Your circumstances has changed (e.g. job loss etc.)
You're dealing with illness or bereavement
You’ve received a large or unexpected bill
You need longer time to pay your bill
You want advice on managing your energy usage
You have a high balance and want to spread payments through monthly direct debit
We’re here to help you find the best solution for your situation.
How to contact
PAR
:
Call:
0818 642 642
Email:
PAR@energia.ie
Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm
I have received a letter from your Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team, what does this mean?
The Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team is part of our Customer Experience team. If you’ve received a letter from them, it’s important not to ignore it.
What the letter means:
•It explains why we’re getting in touch, this could be about a query on your account or an overdue payment.
•It includes contact details so you can speak to us by phone or email.
Please reach out to the team as soon as possible. We’re here to help and will work with you to resolve any issues.
Can the Payment and Accounts Resolutions Team disconnect my supply if I don't pay my bills?
Yes, your electricity or gas supply can be disconnected if bills are not paid and payment terms are not followed. But this is always a last resort.
What you need to know:
Disconnection only happens when all other options have been exhausted.
The team will make every effort to contact you and help you avoid this.
The sooner you get in touch, the sooner we can work with you to find a solution.
How can a Pre-payment Meter help me with my account if I am behind in my bills and payments?
If you're finding it hard to keep up with your energy bills, a pre-payment meter (PPM) can help you manage your account more easily. It lets you pay for your electricity and gas as you use it, which can make budgeting simpler.
Here’s how it works
:
We’ll move your current account balance onto the pre-payment meter.
Each time you top up, 10% goes towards paying off your balance, and 90% goes towards your energy use.
If you rent your home, we’ll need your landlord’s permission before installing a
PPM
. We’ll also check that your current meter is compatible for a
PPM
.

or email

. Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.
I am struggling to pay my bill - however I don’t want to call Energia to discuss - what should I do?
We understand it can be difficult to talk about money. If you’d prefer not to call us, you can email our Payment and Accounts Resolutions team at

.

When you can make a payment or an explanation of your current situation
We’ll work with you to agree on a suitable solution and resolve any issues on your account. We’re here to help, so please reach out as soon as you can.

<script>
    function openAccountsDDL() {
        let ddl = document.querySelector("#account__dropdown-items ul");
        let btn = document.querySelector("#account-dropdown-btn");

        if (ddl) {
            const isOpen = ddl.style.display === "block";
            ddl.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "block";

            if (btn) {
                btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!isOpen));
            }

            if (!isOpen) {
                trapFocus(ddl, btn);
            } else {
                releaseFocus();
            }
        }
    }

    function trapFocus(container, triggerBtn) {
        const focusableSelectors = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
        const focusableElements = container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors);
        const first = focusableElements[0];
        const last = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];

        if (first) first.focus();

        function handleKeyDown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                openAccountsDDL();
                triggerBtn.focus();
                return;
            }

            if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                if (e.shiftKey) {
                    if (document.activeElement === first) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        last.focus();
                    }
                } else {
                    if (document.activeElement === last) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        first.focus();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

        document._accountMenuHandler = handleKeyDown;
    }

    function releaseFocus() {
        if (document._accountMenuHandler) {
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', document._accountMenuHandler);
            document._accountMenuHandler = null;
        }
    }
</script>

    <div class="fr-view">
        <h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left">Energy bills can be confusing..</h2><p>But we’re here to help break it down for you with this short guide to the key information that is included on your bill and what it means for you and your home.</p><h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left">What is a utility bill?</h2><p>A utility bill is a statement that shows how much you owe for essential services such as electricity or gas. It includes details of your energy usage over a set period, along with charges, taxes, and any applicable discounts. Your Energia bill is a type of utility bill, showing exactly how much energy your home has used and how your final cost is calculated.</p><h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left">How your bill is calculated:</h2><p>Your electricity or gas meter records the amount of energy your home has used. ESB Networks or Gas Networks Ireland will read your meter four times per year and share the readings with us to calculate your bill. Outside of these times, we may ask you to provide us with a meter reading to ensure your bill is kept accurate and to avoid estimate readings. Your actual bill will vary depending on your usage, tariff and meter type. You can compare your costs with the <a href="/energy-plans/estimated-annual-bill">average electricity bill in Ireland</a> and learn how annual energy costs are estimated.</p><p>If you have a Smart Meter your meter readings will be automatically sent to the network operators and shared with us to calculate your bill. Please note, depending on your CTF status, bills may be estimated.</p><h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left">How you will be billed:</h2><p>If you have registered for an Energia online account, you will receive your bill online. We will email you to let you know when you have new bill available to view and you can simply log into your online account either on web or via our free smartphone app, to see your latest bill, account balance and the option to download a copy of your bill (and any bill within your account, up to two years).</p><p>If you have not yet registered for an Energia online account, you will receive your bills by post.</p><h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left">Your electricity & gas bills:</h2><p>Electricity and gas are billed separately so, if you’re a Dual Fuel customer, you will receive two separate bills one for electricity and one for gas and each will be paid separately. These bills may not arrive together at the same time and this is normal, don’t worry.</p>
    </div>


    









    <div class="fr-view">
        <h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header">Your electricity and gas bill information</h2><p class="text-widget__text-container__sub-header" style="text-align: left">Your bill will contain two pages of information and it Is important that you review both pages to ensure everything is up to date and as expected.</p><table style="width: 100%"><thead><tr><th><span style="color: rgba(60, 35, 115, 1)">Page 1</span></th><th><span style="color: rgba(60, 35, 115, 1)">Page 2</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="width: 50%"><ul><li>A summary of your current account balance</li><li>Account balance before</li><li>Cost of your bill</li><li>New account balance</li><li>If your account is currently in credit you will see the letter '<strong>CR</strong>'</li></ul></td><td style="width: 50%"><ul><li>Indicates a breakdown of your usage, showing the costs in more detail. If your bill amount has been calculated based on an estimate meter reading you'll see the letter ‘<strong>E</strong>’ in your bill.</li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table><p><br></p><p>If you spot something that doesn’t seem right, check out our Help and Support centre for helpful answers to many billing queries or contact us if you need to chat to our billing team.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="fr-view">
        <h2 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left"><span style="color: rgba(60, 35, 115, 1)"><u>What to look for on your bill</u></span></h2><h3 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left"><span style="color: rgba(60, 35, 115, 1)">Page 1:</span></h3><p style="text-align: left"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 18px">In the top right-hand corner, you will find most of the key account information which includes:</span></p><h4 class="text-widget__text-container__sub-header" style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 24px"><strong><span style="color: rgba(175, 25, 95, 1)">1. Your account number:</span></strong></span></h4><p>This is your Energia account number which identifies your electricity or gas account. You may wish to make note of this number as it will be required should you need to contact us or if you would like to register for an Energia online account.</p><h4 class="text-widget__text-container__sub-header" style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 24px"><strong><span style="color: rgba(175, 25, 95, 1)">2. Your MPRN or GPRN:</span></strong></span></h4><p>Your MPRN (Meter Point Reference Number) of GPRN (Gas Meter Point Reference Number) identifies your meter connection with ESB Network or Gas Networks Ireland and these numbers will be unique to your home.</p><h4 class="text-widget__text-container__sub-header" style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 24px"><strong><span style="color: rgba(175, 25, 95, 1)">3. Billing period and due date:</span></strong></span></h4><p>Your billing period dates relate to the timeframe of the electricity usage you are being billed for. The due date is the date which you must pay your bill by.</p><p>If you are a Level Pay customer, you don’t need to take any action as the cost of your bills will be covered within your monthly direct debit payments which are collected automatically on the due date indicated on your bill.</p><p><br><strong>Also read: </strong></p><ul><li>Understanding <a href="/about-energia/latest-news/proration-change-faqs"> proration in billing</a>.</li><li><a href="/about-energia/latest-news/is-level-pay-worth-it-a-brief-guide-for-energia-customers">Is Level Pay worth it?</a></li></ul><h4 class="text-widget__text-container__sub-header" style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 24px"><strong><span style="color: rgba(175, 25, 95, 1)">4. Bill invoice number:</span></strong></span></h4><p>Each bill has its own invoice number to reference.</p><h4 class="text-widget__text-container__sub-header" style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 24px"><strong><span style="color: rgba(175, 25, 95, 1)">5. Tariff:</span></strong></span></h4><p>This indicates the current Energia energy plan you are being billed on. If your tariff no longer suits your usage, you can <a href="/energy-plans/electricity">compare Energia electricity plans</a> to find a plan that better matches your home, meter type and energy habits.</p><h3 class="text-widget__text-container__header" style="text-align: left"><span style="color: rgba(60, 35, 115, 1)">Page 2:</span></h3><p><span style="font-size: 18px">This is the more detailed itemisation of the costs which make up your final bill amount.  When a price change comes into effect, customer bills will show a breakdown of usage and charges on the old rates and the new rates.</span></p><p>For example, if there is a price change scheduled for the 07 October some of your bill will be calculated using the old rate; this will be based on the number of days before the 07 October and the remainder of your bill will be calculated using the new rate from the 07 October onwards.</p>
    </div>

                <div class="accordion">
                        <h3 class="accordion__control__heading">
                            <button id="accordionControl-a62854b4d62f14231a9197a7a54d461df" class="accordion__control" data-click-text="Accessing and managing bills" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-a62854b4d62f14231a9197a7a54d461df" data-accordion-control="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ Category" data-adobe-accordion-title="Accessing and managing bills">
                                <div class="accordion__control__title">Accessing and managing bills</div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                    <svg width="26" height="24" viewBox="0 0 26 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                        <path d="M12.667 0.5C19.4121 0.500166 24.833 5.67395 24.833 12C24.833 18.326 19.4121 23.4998 12.667 23.5C5.92171 23.5 0.5 18.3261 0.5 12C0.5 5.67385 5.92171 0.5 12.667 0.5Z" stroke="#AF195F"></path>

                        <div id="accordionPanel-a62854b4d62f14231a9197a7a54d461df" class="accordion__panel" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-a62854b4d62f14231a9197a7a54d461df" hidden="">
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a6412eb74b97f423b8282a7ba52169b51" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="Can I pay my bill online?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a6412eb74b97f423b8282a7ba52169b51" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="Can I pay my bill online?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">Can I pay my bill online?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a6412eb74b97f423b8282a7ba52169b51" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a6412eb74b97f423b8282a7ba52169b51" hidden="">
                                    <p>Yes, you can pay your bill online through your Energia online account.</p>

<p><strong>Why register for Energy Online?</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>You get 24/7 access to view your bills and make payments conveniently.</li>
	<li style="text-align: justify;">You can use our <a href="https://www.energia.ie/customer-area/ways-to-pay">Fast Pay service</a> to make advance payments towards your energy bills.</li>
	<li>All payments are secure and easy to manage.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
Register for <a href="https://energyonline.energia.ie/">Energy Online here</a>.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-aa2b313fdfa2844bfb81142687abfa1d2" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="Can I get my bill online instead of by post?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-aa2b313fdfa2844bfb81142687abfa1d2" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="Can I get my bill online instead of by post?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">Can I get my bill online instead of by post?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-aa2b313fdfa2844bfb81142687abfa1d2" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-aa2b313fdfa2844bfb81142687abfa1d2" hidden="">
                                    <p>Yes, you can choose to receive your Energia bill online.<br>
<br>
<strong>Simply register for our Energy Online service, and your bills will be:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Emailed directly to you</li>
	<li>Available to view anytime through your online account</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
This option is secure, convenient, and helps you manage your bills more easily, while also reducing paper waste. You may also be eligible for a discount of 4% on your bill if you choose to receive your bill online.<br>
<br>
<a href="https://energyonline.energia.ie/register/step1/">Register for Energy Online here</a></p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a7f3dc955748e45fbb0f86ed77117f773" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="What payment options does Energia Provide?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a7f3dc955748e45fbb0f86ed77117f773" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="What payment options does Energia Provide?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">What payment options does Energia Provide?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a7f3dc955748e45fbb0f86ed77117f773" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a7f3dc955748e45fbb0f86ed77117f773" hidden="">
                                    <p>We offer a range of payment options to suit different needs and help you manage your energy bills with ease:</p>

<p><strong>1. Direct Debit</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>The full bill amount is automatically taken from your bank account 14 days after your bill is issued.</li>
	<li>It’s a hassle-free way to stay on top of payments and you may be eligible for discounts when you choose this option.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
<strong>2. FastPay</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>A quick and easy way to make debit or credit card payments online.</li>
	<li>You can add credit to your account, which will be deducted from your next bill.</li>
	<li>Great for building up credit.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
<strong>3. Level Pay</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Spread your estimated annual energy costs evenly over 12 monthly payments.</li>
	<li>Monthly payments are calculated based on consumption and we review at least once a year and encourage customers to regularly log in to their online account to review bills.</li>
	<li>We will notify you in advance of any changes to your monthly payment.</li>
</ul>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a31bf2fe8fb3c40eeb87ee9b0be76028e" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="When do I have to pay my bill?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a31bf2fe8fb3c40eeb87ee9b0be76028e" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="When do I have to pay my bill?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">When do I have to pay my bill?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a31bf2fe8fb3c40eeb87ee9b0be76028e" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a31bf2fe8fb3c40eeb87ee9b0be76028e" hidden="">
                                    The Payment Due Date is indicated on the top of the bill. This is generally 14 days after the bill is issued.
                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a14018ca3552b49a1b4f0e6349e9a4f8a" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="Will I receive one bill for both electricity and gas?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a14018ca3552b49a1b4f0e6349e9a4f8a" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="Will I receive one bill for both electricity and gas?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">Will I receive one bill for both electricity and gas?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a14018ca3552b49a1b4f0e6349e9a4f8a" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a14018ca3552b49a1b4f0e6349e9a4f8a" hidden="">
                                    <p>If you're a Dual Fuel customer with Energia, you'll receive two separate bills, one for electricity and one for gas.<br>
<br>
<strong>Here’s why:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Electricity and gas are billed separately, based on the meter reading schedules of ESB Networks (electricity) and Gas Networks Ireland (gas).</li>
	<li>Your bills may be issued on different dates, and each payment will be processed separately.</li>
</ul>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-ae7c2c0cc846a46aba414995b9ae80504" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="Do Energia accept Social Welfare payments?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-ae7c2c0cc846a46aba414995b9ae80504" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="Do Energia accept Social Welfare payments?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">Do Energia accept Social Welfare payments?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-ae7c2c0cc846a46aba414995b9ae80504" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-ae7c2c0cc846a46aba414995b9ae80504" hidden="">
                                    <p>The Social Welfare can’t pay Energia directly, but you can organise for them to make payment directly to you. You will need to make Social Welfare aware when you change supplier.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-abbf30a0a7fc046daaf9c08e0ab284382" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="How can I reduce my bills?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-abbf30a0a7fc046daaf9c08e0ab284382" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="How can I reduce my bills?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">How can I reduce my bills?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-abbf30a0a7fc046daaf9c08e0ab284382" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-abbf30a0a7fc046daaf9c08e0ab284382" hidden="">
                                    <p>There are a few simple ways to lower your energy bills:</p>

<p><strong>1. Choose the right payment options</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>You can get discounts by paying your bill through Direct Debit or by signing up for online billing.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
<strong>2. Check your energy plan</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Make sure you're on a plan that suits your needs. If you're not sure, we can help you review your options. Call our customer support line at <a href="/customer-care-number">0818 405 405</a> to review your options.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
<strong>3. Use less energy at home</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Small changes can make a big difference. We’ve put together an Energy Efficiency Tips Guide with practical ideas to help you save energy and money.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
Visit our <a href="/customer-area/home-energy-efficiency-tips">Energy Efficiency Tips Guide</a> to get started.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-ab55ce1f3e22b49b08413895c0bb8af1f" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="I am struggling to pay my bill – what can I do?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-ab55ce1f3e22b49b08413895c0bb8af1f" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="I am struggling to pay my bill – what can I do?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">I am struggling to pay my bill – what can I do?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-ab55ce1f3e22b49b08413895c0bb8af1f" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-ab55ce1f3e22b49b08413895c0bb8af1f" hidden="">
                                    <p>Please contact us as soon as you start having difficulty paying your bill. The sooner we know, the sooner we can help.<br>
<br>
<!--%3Cmeta%20content%3D%22text%2Fhtml%3B%20charset%3Dus-ascii%22%20http-equiv%3D%22Content-Type%22%20%2F%3E-->
<style type="text/css">a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #464feb;
}
tr th, tr td {
    border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
}
tr th {
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
}
</style>
<strong>Here’s how we can support you:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>We understand financial hardship happens, and we’ll work with you to find the best payment arrangement.</li>
	<li>This may include installing a prepayment meter to help manage your account.</li>
	<li>If you ask, we can also work with charities or third-party agencies to support you. Your information will always be treated in strict confidence.</li>
	<li>Under the <a href="/home/codes-of-practice">EAI Energy Engage Code</a>, we will never disconnect a customer who engages with us to find a solution.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
You can reach our Payment and Accounts Resolutions team by phone on <a href="tel: 0818 642 642"><u> 0818 642 642</u></a> or email <a href="/par-email"><u>PAR@energia.ie</u></a>. Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-abae064db14a24f758073a26ad3ffb21e" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="I have a carer/relative/friend who normally looks after my bills. Can you send my bill to them?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-abae064db14a24f758073a26ad3ffb21e" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="I have a carer/relative/friend who normally looks after my bills. Can you send my bill to them?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">I have a carer/relative/friend who normally looks after my bills. Can you send my bill to them?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-abae064db14a24f758073a26ad3ffb21e" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-abae064db14a24f758073a26ad3ffb21e" hidden="">
                                    <p>Yes, we can arrange to send your bills to someone you trust. If a carer, relative or friend helps you manage your bills, we can redirect your bills to them, with your permission.<br>
<br>
<strong>To do this: </strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Fill in our <a href="/customer-area/vulnerable-customers">online form</a></li>
	<li>Or <a href="/contact-us">contact our Customer Care team</a></li>
</ul>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-aebe2f9ddce784bcdb8138979b10416d8" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="I am blind or visually impaired. How can I receive my bill?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-aebe2f9ddce784bcdb8138979b10416d8" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="I am blind or visually impaired. How can I receive my bill?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">I am blind or visually impaired. How can I receive my bill?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-aebe2f9ddce784bcdb8138979b10416d8" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-aebe2f9ddce784bcdb8138979b10416d8" hidden="">
                                    <p>We offer several accessible billing options to support customers who are blind or visually impaired.<br>
<br>
<strong>You can choose to receive your bill in one of the following formats:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Braille bill</li>
	<li>Large print bill - easier to read and designed for better visibility</li>
	<li>Talk-through option - We can call you and go through your bill details with you over the phone</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
<strong>How to request this service:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>You can fill in an <a href="/customer-area/vulnerable-customers">online form</a></li>
	<li>Or you can <a href="/contact-us">contact our Customer Care team</a></li>
</ul>

<p><br>
We’ll make sure your billing experience is tailored to your needs and handled with care.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-ac3d4e103d18b4742a6a6ae4461b39184" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="Do Energia accept cheque payments?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-ac3d4e103d18b4742a6a6ae4461b39184" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="Do Energia accept cheque payments?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">Do Energia accept cheque payments?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-ac3d4e103d18b4742a6a6ae4461b39184" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-ac3d4e103d18b4742a6a6ae4461b39184" hidden="">
                                    <p>We do not recommend posting and paying with cheques. Energia does not accept responsibility for any unaccounted for cheques. We would recommend paying by direct debit or through your <a href="https://energyonline.energia.ie/">Energy Online account</a>.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a2b719c4408524da7aa767af2e5980dca" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="I receive the Department of Social Protection allowance for electricity or gas. Can I still switch?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a2b719c4408524da7aa767af2e5980dca" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="I receive the Department of Social Protection allowance for electricity or gas. Can I still switch?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">I receive the Department of Social Protection allowance for electricity or gas. Can I still switch?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a2b719c4408524da7aa767af2e5980dca" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a2b719c4408524da7aa767af2e5980dca" hidden="">
                                    <p>Yes of course. You will still receive the allowance. The Department will pay it directly into your bank account and then you use it to pay your bill. Just give the Department a call when you're switching to check all your details are correct.</p>

                                </div>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="accordion__control__heading">
                            <button id="accordionControl-a4bc86cfc4eb34e6b91d0114e7b1e5b05" class="accordion__control" data-click-text="Bill understanding and calculation" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-a4bc86cfc4eb34e6b91d0114e7b1e5b05" data-accordion-control="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ Category" data-adobe-accordion-title="Bill understanding and calculation">

                                <div class="accordion__control__icon">

                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a764e9a395c114b9594e992920b2b8034" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="How is my bill calculated?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a764e9a395c114b9594e992920b2b8034" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="How is my bill calculated?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">How is my bill calculated?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>

                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a764e9a395c114b9594e992920b2b8034" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a764e9a395c114b9594e992920b2b8034" hidden="">
                                    <p>Your Energia bill is based on how much electricity or gas you use. Here’s a simple breakdown of how we calculate it:</p>

<p><strong>1. Reading your meter:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>We measure your energy use in units from your electricity and/or gas meter. ESB Networks (for electricity) and Gas Networks Ireland (for gas) read your meter about four times a year.</li>
	<li>If a recent reading isn’t available, we’ll use an estimated reading based on your previous usage.</li>
	<li>Or you can send us your own meter reading  through your <a href="https://energyonline.energia.ie/">Energy Online account</a> to make your bill more accurate.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
<strong>2. Working out your usage</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>We look at the meter readings at the start and end of your billing period to see how much energy you used.</li>
	<li>If our prices changed during that time, we split your usage:</li>
</ul>

<p>- Units used before the change are charged at the old price.<br>
- Units used after the change are charged at the new price.</p>

<p><br>
<strong>3. Your plan (tariff)</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>We multiply the number of units you used by the price per unit in your energy plan.</li>
</ul>
 

<p><strong>4. Other charges on your bill also includes:</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>A daily standing charge (a fixed cost) </li>
	<li>VAT (Value Added Tax)</li>
	<li>Government charges like:</li>
</ul>

<p>- The PSO Levy (for electricity)<br>
- Carbon Tax (for gas)<br>
 </p>

<p><strong>Want to understand your bill better?</strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>Check out our <a href="/customer-area/understanding-your-bill">Understanding Your Energia Bill Guide</a></li>
</ul>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">

                                    <p>Absolutely, we know your Energia bill might look a little different from what you're used to, and we're here to help. To make things easier, we’ve created a simple guide that explains each part of your bill in plain language.<br>
<br>
View our <a href="/customer-area/understanding-your-bill">Understanding Your Bill Guide here</a></p>

                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-ad35f1e9b2a7140dcbc73770af0310853" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="What are Unit Rates?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-ad35f1e9b2a7140dcbc73770af0310853" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="What are Unit Rates?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">What are Unit Rates?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-ad35f1e9b2a7140dcbc73770af0310853" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-ad35f1e9b2a7140dcbc73770af0310853" hidden="">
                                    <p>Unit rates are the price you pay for each unit of energy you use. Energy is measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh), that’s the amount of electricity used to power things like lights, appliances or heating. Each kWh you use is called a unit.</p>

<p><strong>To work out your energy cost, we multiply:</strong><br>
-The number of units you’ve used<br>
- By the price per unit in your plan (your unit rate)</p>

<p>You’ll see your unit rates clearly listed on your bill, so you can understand how your charges are calculated.</p>

                                </div>
                                <div class="accordion__control__heading">
                                    <button id="accordionControl-child-a0350d578cfa549b4b548f3f387d60567" class="accordion__control accordion__panel__child" data-click-text="What if I am a multi-rate customer?" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordionPanel-child-a0350d578cfa549b4b548f3f387d60567" data-accordion-control-child="" data-adobe-accordion-block="FAQ" data-adobe-accordion-title="What if I am a multi-rate customer?">
                                        <div class="accordion__control__title--child">What if I am a multi-rate customer?</div>
                                        <div class="accordion__control__icon">
                                            <svg class="icon-down-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <use xlink:href="#icon-down-arrow" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"></use>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div id="accordionPanel-child-a0350d578cfa549b4b548f3f387d60567" class="accordion__panel accordion__panel--grandchild" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordionControl-child-a0350d578cfa549b4b548f3f387d60567" hidden="">
                                    <p>If your electricity plan includes different rates for different times of day (like Day, Night or Peak hours), your bill will still look the same as usual. However, if our prices change, you’ll see an extra line on your bill for each rate. This shows the new price per unit for that time period.</p>
